answer_1.quote: We evaluate SAIL-VL's caption performance on the DetailCaps-4870 benchmark... the model generates detail captions and instruction-following responses.
answer_1.outputs: detail captions, OCR text, instruction-following responses

answer_2.quote: We evaluate SAIL-VL's caption performance on the DetailCaps-4870 benchmark with GPT evaluation... For OCR tasks, we compute the ANLS score between the predicted OCR contents and the ground truth ones.

answer_3.quote: We feed the candidate captions and ground truth ones to Azure GPT4O API, and ask the model to judge the candidate caption quality based on the precision and recall of visual elements.

answer_4.quote: We also task human experts to evaluate the data quality... human annotators are given two candidate captions... provide quality scores and a Good-Same-Bad (GSB) judgment.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two captions and assign a GSB judgment and absolute scores based on hallucination, inaccuracy, omission, and language fluency.
